visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro copy beside a lead-capture form (consultant contact, email form), optionally with a contact-details column; submission is not wired to a backend

contentPattern.structure: content rows (heading, intro text, links) then field rows `label | type | options/help` (types: text, email, tel, number, date, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, checkboxes, submit, reset). Content rows after the last field become a contact-details column (phone numbers, addresses). Content rows between fields stay inside the form

reuseGuidance: Use for any contact or lead form beside copy. The form shows a notice on submit; wire it to a form service later. For app sign-in or registration forms use app-form.
decisions: Submission is blocked client-side because the source posts to a CRM EDS cannot reproduce.

Catalog members v_b96311568eb6 / v_92ebe11167df (product jump-link bar) and an accordion + photo instance are not contact forms; they render as plain content here. Reclassify them with excat-catalog-manager.
